settings.title: ships on or before
settings.content:
Why isn't my order shipped immediately upon payment?

With a socially conscious vision and an unwavering commitment to sustainability, we encourage our community of creatives and designers not to overproduce and operate on a made-to-order basis. In light of that, we hope you'd be patient with your order and allow extra time for our creators to craft the jewelry that will stand the test of time.

settings.richtext: Free insured shipping for orders above USD 300

settings.title: the future rocks warranty
settings.content:
Jewelry purchased from The Future Rocks starting from 16th June, 2023 is warranted against any manufacturing defect for a period of 2 years from the date of purchase.

For detailed information and warranty conditions, please view TERMS AND CONDITIONS.

settings.title: fsc-certified packaging
settings.content:
Your jewelry comes in a box made from uncoated pulp coloured papers and boards, with a rough surface. Light fast and FSC® certified.

Environmental features

  • Acid free
  • Heavy metal absence CE 94/62
  • Environmental chlorine free
  • Long life ISO 9706
  • FSC C015523
  • Recycled polyester padding and pouch

settings.custom_text_custm: Please note that the carat weight, gold weight, number of stones, and dimensions will vary depending on the size of the product ordered. Please contact us for more information.

settings.title: Easily Clip On
settings.text: Effortlessly attach charms for a customizable accessory that complements your on-the-go lifestyle. Mix and match to express your unique style.

settings.title: Lab-grown Sapphires
settings.text: These stunning gemstones are crafted to perfection, offering exceptional beauty and uniform color and clarity that enhance their brilliance.

settings.title: Adjustable Chain
settings.text: Adjust the necklace length to wear it as a necklace or double as bracelets, giving you the versatility to shine on any occasion.

settings.title: Durable & Tarnish-Resistant
settings.text: Crafted in 18k gold vermeil and rhodium-plated sterling silver, these necklaces offer superior durability. Resistant to fading and oxidation, they provide a sophisticated look while giving comfort for sensitive skin.
